title: Development of fully automated deep-learning-based approach for prediction of sentinel lymph node metastasis in breast cancer patients using ultrasound imaging.
summary: Automated ultrasound segmentation and CNN image features combined with clinical data predicted pathologically confirmed sentinel-node status in breast cancer. Two-hospital retrospective cohorts included an external hospital test of 113 patients, with AUC about 0.765. The cohort, reference outcome, split and limitations are reported in the paper.
